summary: No new work is started: the run is at the end of its time budget and has no recorded gaps. This submission repeats the state-preserving continue on candidate 70dc8f86c666457abd3005cc666d5931 from the unchanged, preflight-validated draft, so a successor can resume either investigation without the confirmed work being redone. Retained and unchanged: the confirmed implementation violation claim-config-publish-requires-durable-append, proved by direct check 3b256fe6f42b4154b75d4d2ec02e27bf (execution 452a068dbfa1488ea15bc730a0f1e7bd, checker correspondence no_issue_found, outcome violated), in which a leader that received a LogStore.StoreLogs error for a membership-change entry still published that configuration as configurations.latest although the assigned log index was absent from durable storage, and then could not regain leadership because its live quorum counted the unreachable voter. Supporting retained results: the follower-side negative result from exploration 6c1f4fbd37ad49e79cd922b03259d1fe, the real-producer truncation result from exploration 9751d8de6e634624998aa5475f25d523 where the cached and reported last-log index was stranded above durable content, and the separate configuration-index observation from exploration 86b51caa6a8141a9802f09aa24ea13af bounded to misleading telemetry and a lost prevIndex guard for external callers. Boundaries remain explicit and unchanged: StoreLogs failures are injected at the real store boundary, the clusters are in-process and in-memory, and the last-log-cache divergence is kept distinct from the confirmed published-configuration violation. No source, evidence, credential or dependency files were modified; the draft contains submission.json, probe_config_publish_test.go and probe_config_index_test.go.
